form_analysis.feedback: Clear, concise reflexology aftercare form with basic but appropriate guidelines for this holistic therapy. Focuses on hydration, rest, and gentle recovery. Simpler than cosmetic/medical procedure forms as reflexology has lower risk profile. Could be enhanced with more detail on expected reactions and specific hydration targets.

form_data.introduction: The following aftercare advice is essential to help reduce the risk of treatment complications, to improve your comfort and to help achieve the best possible results from treatment.

instructions.general_directive: Please follow the aftercare advice for Reflexology.

sections.title: Beverage Restrictions
sections.content: Avoid drinks with alcohol or caffeine for 12 hours, as they may cause dehydration.

sections.title: Activity Restrictions
sections.content: Avoid any strenuous exercise or exhausting activity for the next 12 hours, to help your body rest, relax and de-stress further.

sections.title: Hydration Guidance
sections.content: Drink plenty of water to keep hydrated.

sections.title: Temperature and Environmental Restrictions
items: Avoid a hot bath for 24 hours.
Avoid sunbeds and UV light for 48 hours.

sections.title: Symptom Management
sections.content: Any muscle aches or headache afterwards you can take simple over the counter pain killers such as paracetamol and Ibuprofen (if medically safe for you).

sections.title: Contact Guidance
items: Contact your therapist if you experience any side effects.
If you are concerned about any problems or side effects following reflexology, then you must contact your therapist for advice as soon as possible.

patient_declaration.reading_confirmation: It is essential that you have read all of the information available. Once you have read and understood all of the below, please sign the declaration at the bottom of this form.
patient_declaration.question_opportunity: Please do let your practitioner know if you have any questions or if you do not understand any of the aftercare instructions provided below.
patient_declaration.declaration_text: I confirm that I have read and understood all the information on this Form and that I have been given the opportunity to ask any questions that have come to mind throughout.
